premise: A gust sends Pinecone rolling down the hill; Woodpecker calls the alarm and Hedgehog chases her the only fast way he knows: rolling.
inspiration: The Gingerbread Man (folk), turned: the runaway doesn't mind being caught, and the chase ends in a giggling heap.
lesson: Friends find their own way to help.

en-US.title: Pinecone Rolls Away
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 12s} {pinecone:enter} Pinecone sat at the top of the hill, in the sun. {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live} She opened her scales wide, like a flower… then closed them up snug and smiled. Then… {canvas:wind 0.7 6s} a gust! {pinecone:spin} She started to roll. {pinecone:face surprised} [excited] Whoa! Roll, roll, roll, down the hill she went. {sfx:roll} Bumpity, bumpity, bump! {woodpecker:enter} Woodpecker came flying to the big tree. [rushed] {woodpecker:live} He tapped the trunk, tap-tap-tap, listened close… tapped once more, and called: {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog! Pinecone's rolling away! Out scurried Hedgehog. He couldn't run fast. But he knew another way. [giggles] He {hedgehog:live hold} tucked in his nose, curled up tight… {hedgehog:spin x3} and rolled after her! Roly-poly, roly-poly… {sfx:bump} Bump! They landed at the bottom, in a soft pile of moss. {hedgehog:live resume} Hedgehog uncurled, peeked out and sniffed. {pinecone:face happy} {hedgehog:face happy} [laughs] Pinecone and Hedgehog lay there, dizzy and {pinecone:wobble} {hedgehog:wobble} giggling. Up in his tree, Woodpecker {woodpecker:hop} chirped a cheer. [happily] Race you up again? said Pinecone. {pinecone:hearts} {hedgehog:hearts}

es-ES.title: Piña se va rodando
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 12s} {pinecone:enter} Piña tomaba el sol en lo alto de la colina. {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live} Abrió sus escamas de par en par, como una flor… luego las cerró bien apretadas y sonrió. Y entonces… {canvas:wind 0.7 6s} ¡una ráfaga! {pinecone:spin} Empezó a rodar. {pinecone:face surprised} [excited] ¡Uuuy! Rueda, rueda, rueda, colina abajo. {sfx:roll} ¡Bum, badabum, bum! {woodpecker:enter} El pájaro carpintero llegó volando al árbol grande. [rushed] {woodpecker:live} Picó el tronco, toc-toc-toc, arrimó el ojo para escuchar… picó otra vez y llamó: {hedgehog:enter} ¡Erizo! ¡Piña se va rodando! Erizo salió correteando. No corría deprisa. Pero sabía otro truco. [giggles] {hedgehog:live hold} Escondió la nariz, se hizo una bola… {hedgehog:spin x3} ¡y salió rodando detrás de ella! Rueda que rueda, rueda que rueda… {sfx:bump} ¡Pum! Aterrizaron abajo del todo, en el musgo blandito. {hedgehog:live resume} Erizo se desenroscó, asomó la nariz y olisqueó. {pinecone:face happy} {hedgehog:face happy} [laughs] Se quedaron allí, mareados y {pinecone:wobble} {hedgehog:wobble} riéndose. Desde su árbol, el carpintero {woodpecker:hop} pió de alegría. [happily] ¿Otra carrera hasta arriba?, dijo Piña. {pinecone:hearts} {hedgehog:hearts}

roll.prompt: a pinecone bouncing and rolling down a grassy hill, light playful bumps

bump.prompt: a soft bump into a cushion of moss
